bio.text: Jennifer Jenkins is the Democratic nominee for Florida's 8th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She earned a bachelor's degree from Florida Atlantic University in 2009 and a graduate degree from the University of Central Florida in 2014, and worked as a speech-language pathologist.
According to her Ballotpedia survey, she served on the Brevard County School Board after winning election in 2020, defeating an incumbent, and has worked in public education.
